usage: 寵物 is used to refer to animals that people keep at home for companionship or amusement.
It functions as a noun and can be used as the subject or object of a sentence.
You can use 寵物 to talk about any kind of pet, such as dogs, cats, or birds.
It often appears in phrases like '養寵物' (to raise a pet) or '寵物店' (pet shop).
When describing your pet, you can add adjectives or specify the type of animal after 寵物.
